note:
Position profile, fp8 arms. The bf16 control is already measured (sm_dump1): |r| has a
slope of -3.21e-07 per token, 95% CI excluding zero on the DECREASING side, and
alpha_within 1.03, i.e. flat-to-slightly-falling and effectively i.i.d. within a sequence.

The hypothesis these cells test: every token attends to a quantised KV cache, so under fp8
the per-token gap should GROW with absolute position and the slope should turn positive.
That is the direct test of the O(T^2) reading of arXiv:2602.01826 Thm 3.1 -- a flat profile
means sequence error accumulates like T, a growing one like T^2. Causal attention makes the
profile measured at 8192 the same quantity as the first 8192 positions of a longer run, so
no max_len sweep is needed.

TP1/CP1 deliberately: the dump only writes under CP=1 (Megatron's zigzag CP shards would
scramble positions) and only from TP rank 0 (other TP ranks hold identical logprobs and
would inflate n, narrowing the bootstrap CI the verdict rests on).

cells.name: e5m2
cells.note: KV cache in fp8_e5m2: coarser mantissa, so the larger effect if the mechanism is real.
